title: Vite Build Optimization Plan
description: A structured plan for a Vite dev/build/config change -- concern, chunking/dedupe/SSR/sourcemap decisions, measured numbers -- so this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/vite_build_optimizer_audit.mjs.

duplicateFrameworkDetected.description: True if a framework (React, etc.) appears more than once in node_modules or the bundle.

dedupeConfigured.description: True if resolve.dedupe lists every duplicated framework.

prebundleThrashObserved.description: True if dev logs show 'new dependencies optimized' repeatedly (pre-bundling thrash from dynamic CJS imports).

optimizeDepsIncludeCoversWarnings.description: True if optimizeDeps.include (or exclude) covers every dep flagged in dev logs.

defaultExportsAreNamedFunctions.description: True if default-exported components are named functions (required for granular React Fast Refresh).

manualChunksConfigured.description: True if build.rollupOptions.output.manualChunks is in use.

manualChunksUsesAbsolutePaths.description: True if manualChunks rules test absolute paths / path.relative(root, id), not bare substrings.

ssrTarget.description: Runtime target of the SSR build, if any.

ssrNoExternalConfigured.description: True if ssr.noExternal is configured appropriately for the target (near-total for edge).

pluginHook.description: The plugin hook being authored, when concern is plugin-authoring.

hookMutatesConfig.description: True if the hook mutates the resolved config object.

sourcemapMode.description: Production sourcemap policy: off (build.sourcemap: false), public (true), hidden, or inline.

largestChunkKB.description: Size of the largest emitted JS chunk in KB, unminified.

chunkSizeIntentional.description: True if a >500KB chunk is a deliberate, documented decision.

visualizerReviewed.description: True if rollup-plugin-visualizer output was reviewed for this change.

buildTimeSeconds.description: Measured production build wall time in seconds.
